cli.help:
========================================================================
                       OHRICUT - Help & Guide
========================================================================

OHRICUT is a tool for quickly creating beats and loops from your own
audio material.

1. GRAPHICAL USER INTERFACE (GUI)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Run without arguments:
  python3 ohricut_app.py

The interface is divided into three tabs:
  - CUT:      Select WAV file, inspect silence & tempo,
              slice to grid. The lower half displays all
              slices with detailed properties.
  - POOL:     Preview slices and manually move them into POOL folders.
              Contains a detail view of all samples loaded into
              the generator.
  - GENERATE: Create beats from the approved POOL.
              Output in GENERATED_MUSIC/.
  - Settings (Drum Mode, Sidechain, Bass, Transitions, Variations) are located under GENERATE.

2. COMMAND LINE (CLI)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Show help:
    python3 ohricut_app.py help (or: hilfe, --help)

- Process file (CUT step):
    python3 ohricut_app.py process /path/to/file.wav (or: verarbeite)

- Generate track (GENERATE step):
    python3 ohricut_app.py generate <Mode> [bars] [bpm] [mood] (or: generiere)
========================================================================
